  • 3-week history of left-sided hearing reduction, left facial numbness (jawline/around ear).  
  • Intermittent tinnitus with associated dizziness.  
  • No limb weakness, dysphagia, dysarthria, visual disturbance, otalgia, otorrhoea, fever, or itch.

  • No other conditions reported.

  • No other regular medicines.  
  • Allergy: Latex.

- Physical activity and nutrition:
  • High baseline physical activity as professional jockey; currently reduced.  
  • Diet not discussed.

  • Left-sided hearing reduction, tinnitus, dizziness—current primary concern.

- Vision problems or recent changes:
